_changes: 2026-11-05, agreed with the user after measuring: stretch limit 35% became max(35%, 1.2 x r.theta/L); face squash by area became folded edges <= 1%; painted share is of visible texels, limit unchanged.

2026-11-05, agreed with the user on 2026-11-06: the overlap measure changed from the absolute position of the hood tip to rest-relative rotation, after the position measure had failed at 0-1 frames. Limit unchanged (2 frames). Rotation lag is 7-12 frames; position lag on the main axis is still about 1 frame. Stiff-hood control fails under the new measure.

2026-11-06, agreed with the user: the overlap gates also need hood rotation range >= 1.2 x the head's. The limit was chosen after seeing the values (motions 1.46-5.49, stiff control 1.0) and the user was told.

2026-11-06, agreed with the user: prop_contact stage, prop into the body <= 5 mm on every frame of every motion. Fixed before measuring, our reading: the bail inside the hand that holds it is the grip, not a collision. It is reported as grip_depth_mm and the prop must stay held on every frame; all other pairs count, including the rest of the lantern against that hand.

2026-11-06, agreed with the user: engine_unreal stage. Their test was: opens without errors, the actions play, the texture shows. Fixed before measuring as the items of that stage: joint distances compared with the file, motion read from the running component, median colour against Blender's flat render. duplicate_textures added to export after Unreal showed one image imported 11 times.

2026-11-06, agreed with the user: the skills count as stable, and may move to the plugin, when a new concept's character and prop pass every gate with no change to skill code and every selftest passes.

2026-11-07, agreed with the user: the bail inside the hand that holds it stays outside the 5 mm limit as the grip, while the mitten is a solid model. The alternative, reshaping the hand to wrap the bail, was declined.

2026-11-07, agreed with the user: a new texture criterion, because a prop passed with torn patches on sides no panel shows. Measured on the saved albedo.png: colour either side of the border between painted and filled texels of a part, averaged over a few texels so painted detail does not count. Limit 6, the same as the worst part colour error, fixed before the fix was measured.
2026-11-07, agreed with the user: a lag at the search limit (a quarter cycle) still passes the overlap gates and is only flagged, as overlap_at_limit in the report.

2026-11-07, agreed with the user after measuring: the seam criterion changed from p95 in the UV image to the median on the surface (painted against filled texels in one small cube, facing the same way). Limit unchanged at 6. The old measure failed all four models at 12.9-32.9 with clean pictures, because p95 picks up strong contrast the drawing really has. Without the fill the new measure reads 10.5-77 and fails all four; p95 stays in the report.

2026-11-07, known failure, limit kept: the lantern's seam reads 8.1 against 6. Cause found: the strip emptied around the drawing's outline lies between a bright gold edge and painted shading on the cap's eave, and half the measured cubes sit on that band. Nothing shows in the flat render. The user chose to investigate; the fill was improved from 10.3 and the measure was not changed again.

2026-11-07, agreed with the user after measuring: a uv_wire stage for props made mostly of thin bars or wire, with utilisation 0.5 instead of 0.6 and everything else unchanged. A birdcage reached .517 and no more in about 200 runs, with packing already rotating and using concave shapes. Utilisation measures wasted texture space, and that cage's texture passed. The ordinary uv stage keeps 0.6.

2026-11-08, agreed with the user: a texture criterion for marks shown twice, after a robot and a bucket passed every gate with doubled rivets and a stepped patch. A painted texel counts when its two strongest panels each give 30% or more and their colours differ by dE 10 or more. Limit 5% of painted texels, fixed before the fix was measured: averaging by facing squared mixes about 45 +/- 12 degrees on a cylinder, sharpening to the 8th power about 45 +/- 3.

2026-11-09, agreed with the user before any attack was measured: one-shot motions (attacks, played once) get animation_oneshot instead of animation, and weapon strikes get motion_attack; the weapon is held rigidly in a socket bone and checked with prop_contact as before (into the body 5 mm). Motions stay in place, the path the game moves the character along is recorded. Kept from the walk and prop gates: foot slide, under and above the ground 5 mm, deformation, overlap lag 2 frames, jumps 15 mm per frame squared, now measured outside the hit and any landing the motion declares. New: the end pose within 10 mm of the pose the next motion starts from; a heavy strike at 24 fps: wind-up 0.15 s or more, strike 0.17 s or less, weapon point 6 m/s or more, its fastest frame within one of the hit frame, and 0.6 m of travel seen from above so the top-down camera reads it. Closure and spacing do not apply to a strike.

2026-11-11, agreed with the user before Musoe's motions were made again: the jump criterion of animation and animation_oneshot no longer limits acceleration itself (15 mm per frame squared), which any fast motion exceeds: kept, a basic attack took 2 s and a run 0.4 m/s. It now compares a frame's change of velocity with the larger of the same two frames earlier and later, plus 2 mm per frame squared for stillness, so playing a motion faster does not change it. Limit 4, fixed from motions already made and pops put in on purpose: thirteen smooth motions (tinbot and Musoe) read 0.07 to 2.24; one frame of the whole body moved 1 cm read 5.5 to 10. A pop in a fast swing reads lower, as it shows less. New for the game's pace: motion_auto_attack, the attack stage plus a basic attack lasting 1.0 s or less from wind-up back to guard; motion_run, the walk stage plus 3.3 m/s or more.

2026-11-11, agreed with the user with the run: spacing no longer divides top acceleration by top speed, which gives 2 pi over the period on any smooth swing, so a quick rhythm failed by itself (a 16-frame run cycle could bob its head 4 mm at most). It is now the crest factor (top over root mean square) of acceleration over that of speed: 1 on any sinusoid at any period, high where speed turns in a kink, as at a linear key. Limit 2.5, fixed from motions already made: eleven smooth tracked motions read 1.03 to 1.53 and the same played three times faster 1.09 to 1.45; the linear-key control read 5.8, and 3.6 played three times faster. Applies to motion_walk, motion_idle, motion_action and motion_run.

2026-11-11, with the user asking for the GLB and Unreal check of a character holding a weapon exported on its own: engine_unreal_weapon. The export puts a socket with the weapon's own frame and a marker at its point into the skeleton; the engine attaches the weapon's file to the socket with no offset, and its point must land on the marker within 5 mm on every sampled pose, the same tolerance as the joints. The weapon's axes in the engine are found by matching its bounding box to the file's, within 0.5 cm.
